displayedVersion: 1.0.0 as verified earlier in the same retained demo document
data: Own synthetic Uhrwerkkammer page with the same imported long Markdown room text; original Archiv/Nera fixtures retained
steps: Created Uhrwerkkammer through Erstellen > Neue Seite.

Pasted the same heading/paragraph Markdown used in our primary native case using the normal Markdown clipboard operation. Logseq split it into blocks per heading and displayed the headings as headings.
Opened Suchen and entered Bernsteinhebel. Three block hits were shown with headings Wartung, Auslösefolge and Schrank 3 and their surrounding text.
Clicked the Auslösefolge hit. The page URL gained an anchor for that block and the block was brought into view.
Clicked its prose, edited the selected section textarea to the new secured-lever text while preserving the heading and adjacent red-button paragraph, and pressed Escape.
Observed the revised section highlighted at the same location, with adjacent Wartung and Rückweg still readable.
additionalKeyboardProbe: Opened Suchen again, entered Bernsteinhebel, and observed three block hits while the default command read Create.
Pressed Return without clicking a block result. The actual result was a new empty Bernsteinhebel page, not opening a matching block.
Used browser Back to return to the still-edited Uhrwerkkammer. The supplementary synthetic empty page remains.
friction: The click route was short and retained the reading location. No navigation detour was observed for it.
In the tested global-search state, Enter created an empty page despite the three existing block hits. Choosing a matching block explicitly avoided that action.
limits: Demo still warns about no persistence without a local directory; none was granted. No competitor disk or fresh-process acceptance claimed.
This is one actual task and a keyboard probe, not a ranking of overall human GM usability.
